label: Programme Health Assessment
description: Assesses the health of large programmes across delivery, governance, stakeholder, risk, and financial dimensions. Produces RAG-rated dashboard with priority recommendations.

claudeKnowledge.description: Programme management health assessment frameworks, P3M3, PMI programme management, OGC Gateway reviews, RAG status assessment

guidedInputs.label: Programme overview
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the programme: name, strategic objective, total budget, duration, current phase, number of constituent projects, and sponsoring organization.
e.g. Digital Transformation Programme, strategic objective: migrate core banking to cloud platform, budget EUR 45M, started Jan 2024, end date Dec 2026, 8 workstreams, sponsored by CEO and CIO.

guidedInputs.label: Current status and concerns
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the current programme status, known concerns, and what has prompted this health assessment.
e.g. Programme is 14 months in and 8 months behind schedule. Steering Committee has requested independent review. Three key vendors have raised delivery concerns. Programme Director changed 3 months ago.

guidedInputs.label: Available health indicators
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Provide any available programme data: status reports, milestone achievement history, budget spend vs. plan, issue/risk counts and trends, stakeholder feedback, or audit findings.
e.g. Last 3 status reports all Red. Budget: 62% of funds spent, 40% of milestones achieved. 12 open Critical issues. Stakeholder survey: sponsor satisfaction 3.2/5.

guidedInputs.label: Assessment dimensions
guidedInputs.description: Select which dimensions to assess (default: all).
